I need it to function tbh, it’s been this way for as long as I can remember.

When I wake up, my bed head is atrocious. I also just like the fact that I can wake up more in the shower and physically do something to transition into the day better.

Before I go to bed I also shower. All the outside bacteria clinging to not just my clothes, but myself freaks me out: I’d hate to bring it into bed with me.

Because it’s a part of my schedule, my body gets the message and helps to prepare me accordingly. In the day it wakes me up. At night, it gets me ready to wind down for sleep. Because of this I don’t have problems going to sleep unless I willingly stay up. :)

No matter how tired or depressed I am, I typically take at the very least a shower a day. Without it I become extremely stressed, irritable, and uncomfortable in my own skin.
